definitions.explanation: Lacking focus or concentration; spread out without clear direction.

examples.japanese: {注意|ちゅうい}が{散漫|さんまん}になる。
{散漫|さんまん}な{話|はなし}し{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: To speak in a scattered manner.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れて{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}が{散漫|さんまん}になってしまった。
examples.english: I got tired and my concentration became scattered.

notes:
{散漫|さんまん} is commonly used to describe a state of being unfocused or lacking concentration.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {注意|ちゅうい}が{散漫|さんまん}: attention is scattered/unfocused
- {集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}が{散漫|さんまん}: concentration is scattered

RELATED WORDS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}: concentration (antonym)
- {漫然|まんぜん}: aimless, vague
- {雑然|ざつぜん}: cluttered, disorderly (physical disorder)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {散漫|さんまん}な{態度|たいど}: an unfocused attitude
- {散漫|さんまん}な{文章|ぶんしょう}: scattered/unfocused writing
